name: David A. Miller, Attorney (NJ Realty Lawyer)
what_they_do: Solo practice concentrated on residential and commercial real-estate purchases, sales and refinances, plus wills/estate planning, probate, LLC and corporation formation and small-business sales; the site says he also prepares income tax returns in tax season.
customers: Home buyers and sellers (many first-time), refinancers, and small-business owners.

size_signals.signal: Solo attorney; asks callers to 'ask to speak with me' and says he is generally in the office
'in practice for over 30 years'; undergraduate accounting degree and LLM in Taxation from NYU Law
Google listing shows only 4 reviews and an unclaimed profile

website_review.primary_cta: 'Call us for a FREE consultation 732-238-5699' text in the header; no form
website_review.trust_signals: 30+ years, LLM Taxation, photo of the attorney, first-person service promise
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright 2023; no viewport meta so phones render the desktop layout at 980px with tiny text; static .php pages; contact page says 'Located in Manalapan, NJ' while the Google listing says East Brunswick; aol.com email
website_review.search_basics: Title is just 'David Miller'; no meta description; no JSON-LD; a small practice-areas page exists; no click-to-call
top_issues: Google profile is unclaimed with a 3.0 star average
Site is not mobile-responsive (no viewport tag) and has no contact form or tel: link
NAP conflict: site says Manalapan, Google says 77 Milltown Rd East Brunswick
Title/meta give search engines nothing to rank for

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: GBP is explicitly unclaimed ('Claim this business'), shows a 3.0 rating from 4 reviews, no photos; robots.txt returns 404 so nothing is blocked. Answerable: a single long first-person page is crawlable, but there is no schema, no meta description, no hours text, and two different addresses for the same practice. Bookable: no form and no scheduling - email and phone only.

operations_signals.signal: Owner says he is 'generally available during the work week, for meetings and phone calls' - intake and scheduling are entirely manual
A public review quotes the office rescheduling an appointment ('need to reschedule your appointment'), suggesting manual calendar handling
Real-estate closing work is document-heavy (deeds, contracts, title) with no client portal visible

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google profile (categories, services, hours, photos, correct address) and fix the Manalapan/East Brunswick NAP conflict
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps card shows 'Claim this business'; site footer says 'Located in Manalapan, NJ' while the listing address is 77 Milltown Rd, East Brunswick

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the static page with a responsive site (viewport meta, tel: links, closing-quote form, real page titles)
top_opportunities.evidence: No viewport meta - renders at 980px on a 390px phone; zero forms; title 'David Miller'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated closing-status updates for buyer/seller clients (milestone emails from a checklist)
top_opportunities.evidence: Solo attorney personally handles every closing and answers his own phone; no client portal or status page on the site

scores.reasons: Gap: unclaimed profile, unresponsive site, no form, no schema, wrong-town NAP. Pay: solo, moderate real-estate fees. Ease: everything on the list is fast and cheap to fix. Evidence: direct screenshots, HTML checks and the Maps card.
